name: Alterian
title: Celestine / Alterian Enclave
description: Sophisticated, long-lived magi-tech scholars, diplomats, and navigators of the Alterian Enclave who harmonize high technology with metaphysical energy.
body:
Parent Lineage: Aeld Overview
The Aeld are an ancient, graceful humanoid species characterized by agility, profound longevity (lifespans exceeding 600 years), and an innate metaphysical connection to arcane energies. Known historically in ancient Terran myths as 'Elves', modern Aeld have evolved into a spacefaring, technologically sophisticated civilization mastering the synthesis of science and sorcery (Magi-Tech). They navigate the cosmos using crystalline hulls, solar sails, and aetherium conduits. Their extensive lifespan allows them to master multiple vocations, viewing reality with long-term strategic patience.

Sociological Profile & Culture:
The Alterian Enclave represents the primary political, cultural, and mercantile body of the Aeld in the Tangent universe. Centered around the capital world of Altheria, the Enclave is an outwardly focused civilization that actively engages in galactic trade, multilateral diplomacy, and cosmic exploration. They view magic not as mystical superstition, but as a rigorous mathematical science—'The Flow'—which governs energy, matter, and history. Alterians deliberately avoid isolationism, serving across the Reach as impartial mediators, arcane engineers, and stellar navigators.

Clan Appearance & Semiotics:
- Lansmarr Clan: Pale skin, luminous crystalline eyes, and silver or platinum hair.
- Lanaran Clan: Pale alabaster skin with dark blue to raven-black hair.
- Silvermoon Clan: Deep mahogany complexions contrasted by black or spun-silver hair.
- Architectural Semiotics: Tiered crystalline spires, solar filament collectors, levitating pavilions, and fine line filigree woven into protective void-suits.
mechanic: Native Aeld Chassis grants complete immunity to magical and mundane sleep effects. Character creation parity cap for Agility and Intellect is raised to +5. Faction and Occupational features with the Alterian tag receive a 1 BP discount (minimum 1 BP). Grants 20 bonus Skill Ranks at character creation.
note: Standard baseline player species for Alterian Enclave campaigns.

name: Doppelganger
title: Shifter / Silvermoon Infiltrator
description: Ancient shape-shifting Aeld lineage bred through specialized Clan Silvermoon sorcery to serve as elite covert investigators and hunters of corruption.

Their purpose was to track, infiltrate, and eliminate metaphysical threats and clandestine corruption across sentient worlds. They possess the unique ability to flawlessly mimic the physical dimensions, vocal patterns, and mannerisms of any observed humanoid.

Operating in the liminal space between identities, Doppelgangers maintain a rigorous internal meditation practice to prevent ego dissolution. In their natural state, they resemble tall, slender Aeld with pearlescent, semi-fluid skin and featureless facial structures until a chosen guise is projected.
mechanic: Alter Form (Humanoid) permits complete anatomical disguise as a Standard Action, granting Advantage on Deception checks to maintain cover. Sense Evil functions as a passive detection sphere with a 30-foot radius against entities with hostile metaphysical resonance. Inherits all base Aeld sleep immunities.
note: High utility for espionage, intrigue, and detective archetypes.

title: Nocturne / Tribunal Disciple
description: Austere, isolationist Aeld governed by the Kovian Tribunal, dedicated to cold rationalism, psychic defense, and arcane purity.

Their society is built around fortified subterranean citadels and high-orbit redoubts designed to prevent cultural contamination. They channel their metaphysical talents into defensive warding, mental projection, and uncompromising judicial martial arts.

Aesthetic Profile:
Monochrome dark armoring, sharp obsidian angular plates, minimal ornamentation, and veil-draped hoods. They speak in hushed, formal tones using an archaic high dialect.
mechanic: Gains +10 Ranks in Metafocus Discipline skills. Mental Fortification grants Advantage on all Will saves against psychic intrusion, mind control, and emotional manipulation. Charisma penalty applies strictly to diplomacy with non-Aeld species.
note: Ideal for austere battle-clerics, inquisitors, and psychic wardens.

description: Feral, primeval Aeld from beyond the Reach who possess instinctual beast transformations and permanent predatory traits.

mechanic: Alter Form (Advanced Animal) allows seamless shape-shifting into up to 3 distinct animal forms (predator, scout, aquatic/aerial) as a Move Action. While in beast form, physical attributes scale to the form and natural weapon attacks deal 1d8+Str lethal damage. Inherits Aeld agelessness and sleep immunity.
note: High-tier combat shifter and survivalist chassis.

name: Ferren
title: High-Canopy Spritelike
description: Slender, elf-like sylvan beings with prehensile split tails, gifted with hyper-mobility and extraordinary sensory multitasking across high forest canopies.
body:
Parent Lineage: Asi Overview
The Asi are ethereal, sylvan, and elemental beings deeply woven into the metaphysical fabric of planetary biospheres. Ageless, sleepless, and naturally obscured by illusions, the Asi range from microscopic fairy mimes to towering quadruped guardians and living crystalline entities. Rather than constructing heavy industrial infrastructure, the Asi utilize the living architecture of the biosphere, guiding nature through advanced Metafocus manipulation.

Sociological Profile & Semiotics:
Ferren are characterized by a slender, athletic build and an iconic split tail that dynamically offsets kinetic momentum during complex aerial leaps. Outsiders often mistake their rapid shifting of attention for distractibility, when it is in fact an advanced cognitive capability for parallel sensory processing. A Ferren effortlessly balances spatial terrain mapping, acoustic tracking, and olfactory detection concurrently.
mechanic: Prehensile split tail grants +4 to balance checks and allows grappling or tool manipulation as a free off-hand action. Climbspeed matches Groundspeed (40 ft). Fast Move grants Advantage on Reflex saves to evade falling or environmental hazards.
note: Acrobatic scout and rapid traversal specialist.

name: Dar
title: Ascendant Martial Artist
description: Athletic, psychic-attuned feline humanoids who excel in three-dimensional martial arts, zero-G acrobatics, and bio-tech weaponry.
body:
Parent Lineage: Aulurans Overview
The Aulurans are an agile, predatory, and technologically advanced feline species native to the vibrant world of Aulura. Characterized by prehensile tails, prehensile feet, low-light vision, keen olfactory senses, and natural claw weaponry, they master 3D environmental navigation and advanced biotechnology. Culturally, they organize into honor-driven prides with a rich tradition of martial arts and psychic metaphysics.

Sociological Profile:
The Dar represent the cultural and philosophical vanguard of the Auluran race. Blending martial discipline with latent psychic focus, they serve as elite fleet scouts, dueling champions, and diplomatic envoys. Their fur displays intricate swirling rosettes or solid smoky hues, and their four prehensile limbs allow them to fight effortlessly in zero gravity.
mechanic: Natural claw attacks deal 1d6+Str kinetic damage. Prehensile feet allow grasping tools or weapons without penalty. Gains Advantage on Acrobatics and climbing maneuvers.
note: Agile kinetic striker with built-in zero-G adaptation.

name: Graa

name: Awakened Animal
title: Sapient Uplift
description: Terrestrial or alien animals that have undergone spontaneous or deliberate metaphysical awakening into full sapience.
body:
Sociological Profile & Psychology:
Awakened animals retain their foundational physical form, instincts, and inherent traits of their original species while acquiring sapient cognition, speech, or telepathy. The transition often causes complex psychological reconciling between primal instincts and rational intellect.
mechanic: Retains native animal physical attacks and senses (e.g. Scent, Low Light Vision). Must acquire telepathy or specialized speech collar if anatomy lacks vocal cords.
note: Customizable uplift chassis based on chosen animal archetype.

name: Caprian
title: Horned Ungulate Stalker
description: Formidable horned humanoids with cloven hooves, predatory fangs, and remarkable mountain agility evolved from predatory bovidae.
body:
Sociological Profile:
Caprians are muscular humanoids whose lower limbs terminate in hard cloven hooves. Evolved from predatory mountain bovidae, they possess sweeping horns, acute senses, and tough claws. They are renowned across the galaxy as relentless mountain rangers, mercenaries, and survivalists.
mechanic: Horns deal 1d8+Str piercing gore damage on a charge. Sure-Footed allows ignoring difficult terrain penalties from steep rocky slopes. Groundspeed 40 ft.

name: Human
title: Standard Terran Homo Sapiens
description: Adaptable, resilient, and resourceful baseline humans who thrive across all planetary environments and vocational disciplines.
body:
Parent Lineage: Humans Overview
Humans are the ubiquitous, highly adaptable, and ambitious cornerstone of the Core Worlds and expanding frontiers. Lacking extreme biological specializations, humans thrive through sheer versatility, political ingenuity, rapid technological development, and cultural plasticity across thousands of colonized planetary systems.

Sociological Profile:
Base humans represent the un-modified genetic baseline of the human species. Their strength lies in their rapid learning capacity, cultural resilience, and diplomatic flexibility, making them prominent across corporate conglomerates, independent crews, and frontier coalitions.
mechanic: Gains 1 bonus Feature of choice at character creation and 10 bonus Skill Ranks across any chosen skills. No innate social stigma penalties.
note: Standard baseline chassis for universal versatility.

name: Gen-E
title: Base Engineered Humanoid
description: Clean-slate genetically enhanced humans engineered for optimized physical performance, immune resistance, and cellular longevity.
body:
Parent Lineage: Humans, Engineered (Gen-E) Overview

Sociological Profile:
Base Gen-E individuals are engineered from birth with optimized telomeres, zero genetic flaws, and reinforced immune systems. They often serve in high-ranking administrative, athletic, and military officer roles.
mechanic: Total immunity to biological diseases and pathogens. +2 bonus to any single attribute of choice.

name: Manelli
title: The Cerebral Expression / Brood-Master
description: Mimetic leadership caste of the Kitin Collective possessing smooth human-like dermis, sensory antennae, and master command over the psionic Chorus.
body:
Parent Lineage: Kitin Collective Overview
The Kitin Collective is a monogenetic biocracy and psionic hive-state birthed from the Genomatrix—a self-aware biological engine reservoir of Proto-Flux. Every Kitin variant shares emerald-green copper blood (hemocyanin), an internal endoskeleton, radiation resistance, and a 4-hour conscious Torpor cycle (no sleep or dreams). Technology is grown from Hive-Resin and bio-piped directly into users' neural circulation. The hive is unified by The Chorus—a continuous 24/7 psionic data stream.

Sociological Profile:
The Manelli are the diplomatic, intellectual, and genetic architects of the Kitin. Lacking the heavy obsidian exoskeleton of lower strains, they possess a human-mimetic skin to interact with external civilizations while coordinating brood development through psionic steering.
mechanic: Can broadcast commands across The Chorus up to planetary distances. Advantage on all radiation resistance checks. Torpor replaces sleep with 4 hours of conscious rest.

name: Jorni
title: Prehensile Saurian Hunter
description: Powerful saurian humanoids with dense scaled skin, prehensile counter-balancing tails, and rapid cellular regeneration.
body:
Sociological Profile:
Native to the tropical rainforests and mangrove swamps of Jorn V, the Jorni are robust reptilian hunters. Their long muscular tails serve as fifth limbs for climbing and underwater propulsion.
mechanic: Regeneration regrows lost digits and limbs over time. Fast Heal doubles natural recovery rate during Light Rest. Groundspeed 40 ft.

name: Kannid
title: Canine Pack-Kin
description: Loyal, keen-sensed canine humanoids who excel in tactical coordination, endurance running, and olfactory tracking.
body:
Sociological Profile:
Kannids are social pack humanoids hailing from temperate scrublands and dense forests. Built with athletic digitigrade legs, lupine muzzles, and expressive ears, their culture centers around unbreakable clan oaths and squad brotherhood.
mechanic: Uncanny Senses grant Advantage on all Perception checks involving hearing or scent. Pack Tactics provides +1 Strike bonus when adjacent to an ally targeting the same foe.

name: Kizin
title: Cunning Vulpine Humanoid
description: Agile, sharp-witted vulpine humanoids with brush tails, keen night vision, and natural aptitude for stealth and tech tinkering.
body:
Sociological Profile:
Kizin are lithe fox-like humanoids native to temperate woodlands. Known for their curiosity, quick wit, and technical adaptability, they frequently work as scouts, communications technicians, and agile rogues.
mechanic: Digitigrade physiology increases Groundspeed to 40 ft. Scent and Low Light Vision provide heightened situational awareness.

name: Kongi
title: Cavern Simian Brute
description: Powerful simian humanoids from high-gravity cavern systems with prehensile feet, stone-climbing prowess, and immense physical surges.
body:
Sociological Profile:
Evolving in massive subterranean cavern megastructures under heavy planetary gravity, Kongi possess dense muscular frames, dark fur coats, and exceptional upper-body strength. They navigate cavern ceilings and cliff faces with ease.
mechanic: Climbspeed equals Groundspeed (30 ft). Mighty Surge adds +2 to Strength checks and damage for 1 round once per combat encounter.

name: Mobula
title: Marine Manta-Shifter
movement: 30 ft Swimspeed (60 ft in Ray Form)
description: Aquatic shifters who seamlessly transition between an amphibious humanoid form and a massive, swift pelagic manta ray.
body:
Sociological Profile:
Native to the deep oceanic planet of Pelagia, Mobula grew deeply reclusive after historical incursions by external empires. They possess smooth cerulean skin with white ventral patterns and broad dorsal folds that expand into massive wings when shifting into ray form.
mechanic: Bi-Form shifting is a Move Action. In Ray Form, Swimspeed increases to 60 ft and Echolocation grants 30 ft Blindsense underwater.

name: Mondi
title: Celestial Psionic Architect
description: Ancient, reclusive psychic humanoids with glowing bioluminescent skin patterns who hover via innate telekinesis and master high metaphysics.
body:
Sociological Profile:
The Mondi are the original organic progenitors of the Mekan. Believed nearly extinct, they maintain deep monastic sanctums where they explore the fundamental harmonics of reality. Their bodies pulse with radiant, mood-sensitive bioluminescence.
mechanic: Permanent telekinetic hover flight (30 ft Flightspeed). Adaptive Aspects allows rerolling one failed mental or technical check per session. Telepathy range 500 ft.

name: Orll
title: Heavy Mountain-Kin (Space Orc)
description: Dense, tusked green-skinned alpine warriors possessing thick fur, natural dermal armor, and devastating combat rage.
body:
Parent Lineage: Orll Overview
The Orll are a heavy-gravity humanoid race characterized by dense muscular frames, pronounced lower tusks, thick insulating fur, and a natural light exoskeleton. Adapted to harsh alpine biospheres, they embody unstoppable physical momentum, survivalist endurance, and combat ferocity.

Sociological Profile:
Living in rugged mountain clans, the Orll emphasize strength, survival, and clan loyalty. Despite unfair stereotyping as savages by technologically reliant factions, they possess a rich oral history and master cold-weather metallurgy.
mechanic: Light Exoskeleton provides DR 2/- against kinetic damage. Rage grants +2 Strength and temporary Vitality in combat. Tusk attack deals 1d6+Str piercing damage.

name: Gra'Or
title: Grey Orll / Photosynthetic Line
description: Evolved grey-to-violet skinned Orll lineage possessing photosynthetic chloroplast dermis that supplements metabolic sustenance.
body:
Parent Lineage: Orll Overview
The Orll are a heavy-gravity humanoid race characterized by dense muscular frames, pronounced lower tusks, thick insulating fur, and a natural light exoskeleton. Adapted to harsh alpine biospheres, they embody unstoppable physical momentum, survivalist endurance, and combat ferocity.

Sociological Profile:
The Gra'Or represent an evolved, philosophically composed branch of the Orll. Their skin contains active chloroplasts that absorb solar radiation, drastically reducing food requirements while preserving massive physical power.
mechanic: Chloroplast trait cuts food consumption by half when exposed to sunlight and accelerates light rest recovery by 50%. DR 2/- from Light Exoskeleton.

name: Plasm
title: Awakened Amorphous Ooze
description: Sentient, translucent amorphous slime entities capable of rapid cellular regeneration, shape-shifting, and squeezing through microscopic apertures.
body:
Sociological Profile:
Plasm are sapient colonial organisms composed of dense, psycho-reactive protoplasm. Possessing no static skeleton or internal organs, they mold their viscosity and shape at will, communicating via telepathy and chemical luminescence.
mechanic: Immune to critical hits, precision damage, and bleeding. Can squeeze through gaps as narrow as 1 inch. Fast Heal and Regeneration rapidly rebuild lost mass.
note: Ultimate amorphous infiltrator and resilient shapeshifter.

name: Praeti
title: Saura-Raptric Flyer
description: Graceful winged avian-pterosaur humanoids possessing wide leathery wings, acute telescopic eyesight, and aerial combat mastery.
body:
Sociological Profile:
Pronounced 'Ray-Tie', the Praeti evolved from raptorial avians across towering mesa spires. Equipped with powerful feathered-leathery wings and predator optics, their society values aerial dogfighting, cartography, and long-range scouting.
mechanic: Flightspeed 30 ft. Uncanny Sense (Vision) grants Advantage on all visual Perception checks and allows spotting fine details up to 2 miles away.

name: Ila
title: The Transcendent Entity / Elohim
description: Transcendent celestial progenitor entity that shifts between solid alabaster polymatter and pure psionic energy at will.
body:
Parent Lineage: Progenitors Overview
The Progenitors are incomprehensibly ancient, godlike cosmic architects whose origins predate modern galactic records. Masters of Level 5+ Technology and Level 5+ Metaphysics, they engineered the Translux Jumpgate network and seeded humanoid life across multiple galactic sectors. They are immortal, ageless, and command all metaphysical channels simultaneously.

Sociological Profile & Aesthetics:
The Ila (Elohim) represent transcendent psionic-theurgy. Appearing as towering celestial figures draped in hard-light wings and gold-filigreed polymatter robes, their presence commands absolute awe and terror. They do not use standard computers or AI, controlling reality directly through thought.
mechanic: Awakened across all 6 Metaphysic Disciplines with Intellect scaling. Flicker Movement allows instantaneous short-range teleportation up to 30 ft as a Move Action. Immortal and ageless.

name: U'Nonn
title: Abyssal Void-Shaper / Anunnaki
description: Ancient colossal architects of the galactic jumpgates, combining monumental Mesopotamian aesthetics with godlike psionic physics.

mechanic: Full attunement across all 6 metaphysical channels. Immune to physical senescence, poison, disease, and vacuum. Commands massive telekinesis and spatial anchoring.

name: Gallen'A
title: Emissaries of the Ila
description: Ethereal angelic heralds created by the Ila to deliver decrees, guide awakening species, and safeguard ancient sacred conduits.

mechanic: Telepathic broadcast up to 10 miles. Hardlight flight provides 40 ft Flightspeed with hover. Gains +20 Ranks in Metafocus Discipline skills.

name: Qeric
title: Six-Limbed Arboreal Rodentia
description: Cute, incredibly fast six-limbed arboreal rodentia who glide between canopy branches via patagia and possess six prehensile paws.
body:
Sociological Profile:
Pronounced 'Ker-Ik', the Qeric are small, friendly, and hyperactive arboreal humanoids. Possessing thick fluffy coats, large dark eyes, and six fully manipulative limbs, they have loose concepts of personal property, obsessively collecting shiny curios and tools.
mechanic: Six multidextrous limbs allow wielding items or climbing while keeping hands free. Patagia allows gliding up to double Groundspeed (60 ft). +2 Defense from Small size.
note: Charming canopy scavenger and hyper-mobile scout.

name: Sefalin
title: Abyssal Cephalopoid / Squid-Taur
description: Aquatic squid-taurs with eight powerful prehensile tentacles, chromatophore camouflage, and advanced bio-psychic biotechnology.
body:
Sociological Profile:
Sefalin are intelligent cephalopoid aberrations featuring a humanoid upper torso rising from a muscular mass of eight tentacles. Originating in abyssal trenches, they build living bio-luminescent coral structures and utilize psionic bio-tools.
mechanic: Prehensile Tentacles allow multi-grapple maneuvers against up to 4 targets simultaneously. Chameleon skin provides +4 to Stealth. Amphibious and pressure immune.
note: Abyssal grappling specialist and bio-tech mystic.

name: Sha'Nor
title: Harbinger of Entropy / Dark Hunger
description: Terrifying smoke specters of entropy and void energy who can assume solid form at will and drain life force from mortal prey.
body:
Parent Lineage: Sha'Nor Overview
The Sha'Nor (Harbingers of Entropy / Smoke Demons) are spectral, planar aberrations whose native state is a swirling, semi-corporeal humanoid specter of solid black smoke and cold void energy. Ageless, immortal, and telepathic, they manipulate the Void and Entropy channels of metaphysics.

Sociological Profile:
Known across civilized worlds as 'Smoke Demons', the Sha'Nor embody cosmic decay and entropy. They require periodic siphoning of vitality or life force to maintain their cohesion across physical space.
mechanic: Semi-Corporeal state grants DR 10 against non-magical kinetic attacks and permits hovering flight. Vampiric flaw requires feeding on life energy; successful melee touch restores Vitality.
note: Spectral entity with terrifying metaphysical dominance.

body:
Parent Lineage: Synthetics Overview
Synthetics are artificial beings ranging from mass-produced silicon androids to transcendent living machines (Mekan). Standard synthetic chassis possess complete immunity to biological ailments, sleep, asphyxiation, and bleeding, substituting Vitality with Structure Points (SP = Health x 1.5) that must be repaired via Engineering. Their digitized minds grant Advantage on saves against mental intrusion, while robotic strength enhances physical lifting.

Sociological Profile:
Androids are humanoid synthetic citizens manufactured for industrial, research, and security applications. Possessing self-aware algorithms, they seek self-determination and civic recognition across galactic polities.
mechanic: Resilient Design provides innate DR 5/- against kinetic attacks. Digitized Mind grants Advantage on all Will saves vs psionic or magical compulsion.
